_comment: Known defects inherited from upstream 2.2 and from this fork's own earlier work, with the issue that tracks each one. Reported but not failing, so new violations are visible. This ledger only shrinks - remove entries as the referenced issues are fixed. Regenerate deliberately, never to silence a new failure. It is currently EMPTY, for the third time: #373 cleared the 22 item-curve rows, #334 the 47 merge-value rows, #478 reverted #50 rather than carrying its two tag-form rows, and #476 rehomed the Trembling Dunes three rather than carrying its one. An empty ledger means every violation the validator can report is a new one, which is the state it was always meant to reach.
